assumptions.assumption: A collection template expression has a collection kind, which is represented by the 'kind' attribute in CollectionTemplateExpression class.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R4: An element of a model pattern is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for 'element of a model pattern'.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R5: A template expression can be bound to a variable is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a method to bind a template expression to a variable in the TemplateExp class.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6: An object template expression may contain multiple property template items is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between ObjectTemplateExp and ObjectTemplateItem class, and ensure ObjectTemplateItem can have multiple instances.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R9: A property template item has exactly one Object Template Expression as its object container is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Create a class for 'PropertyTemplateItem' and add a relationship to ObjectTemplateExp.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R10: A property template item has exactly one property as its referred property is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Create a class for 'PropertyTemplateItem' and add an attribute for the property.
